title: Resting EEG
description: This dataset contains resting-state EEG recordings collected using a 128-channel Amps 300 amplifier at the University of Oklahoma, alongside structural MRI scans acquired from the same participants. The data support investigation of whole-brain electrophysiological functional connectivity dynamics during resting-state conditions.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded with a 128-channel Amps 300 amplifier (Electrical Geodesics Inc.) at 1000 Hz sampling rate during resting state. Structural MRI was acquired using a GE MR750 scanner with GE's BRAVO sequence (FOV=240mm, 180 axial slices per slab). Preprocessing in EEGLAB included band-pass filtering (0.5-100 Hz), notch filtering (58-62 Hz), removal of noisy channels and artifacts (eye blinks, muscle movements, heartbeats), interpolation of bad channels, re-referencing to the average of all electrodes, and downsampling to 250 Hz. No data segments were removed to preserve continuity.
